name: Beetaloo Energy Australia Limited
summary: Beetaloo Energy Australia Limited, along with its subsidiaries, is an Australian enterprise focused on the extraction and commercialization of oil and natural gas. The company holds a full 100% working interest across roughly 28 million acres of exploration acreage located onshore within Australia's Northern Territory, specifically encompassing the McArthur Basin and Beetaloo Sub-basin. Founded in 1981, this Sydney-headquartered firm previously operated as Empire Energy Group Limited, adopting its present name in June 2025.
